lines.text: You passed the test? Big W!

data.define: Used to celebrate a success or good result.

example.text: You passed the test? Big W!

misuse.text: Don't say 'big W' to someone who lost.

data.l1: kemenangan besar; kemenangan luar biasa; big w

native.tip: “big W” = kemenangan besar; kemenangan luar biasa; big w. Contoh: “You passed the test? Big W!”
native.caption:
Apa arti “big W”?
“big W” = kemenangan besar; kemenangan luar biasa; big w.
Contoh: “You passed the test? Big W!” (Kamu lulus tes? "big W"!)
